summary: The log filter returns the logarithm of a number to a given base, natural log by default, passing through to Python's math.log.
questions: How do I calculate a logarithm in an Ansible template?

answer_card.title: log filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ n | log(base) }}` returns the logarithm of `n` to the given base; by default the **natural** logarithm. It passes through to Python's `math.log`.
